# catalyst_projects (Data Source)

List projects visible to the authenticated user in the provider's organization and data center. Requires the `ZOHOCATALYST.projects.Read` OAuth scope. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID; an account with no visible projects returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_projects" "example" {}

output "project_ids_by_name" {
  value = { for project in data.catalyst_projects.example.projects : project.name => project.id... }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `projects` (Attributes List) Visible projects, sorted by ID. IDs are strings to preserve precision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Project domain URL; null if absent.
- `domain_name` (String) Project domain name; null if absent.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `project_type` (String) Project type; null if absent.
- `timezone` (String) Project timezone; null if absent.
